subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this protected macOS onboarding PR be closed as superseded by the merged current-main setup work, or should a contributor rebase/extract a narrow remaining change from it?
rationale: The `maintainer` label blocks automated cleanup, and deciding whether the branch has any unique product value after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99767 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99935 requires maintainer intent rather than a deterministic code fix.

options.title: Close as superseded after maintainer confirmation
options.body: Treat the merged local Gateway bootstrap and Crestodian onboarding work as the canonical direction, preserving any useful discussion links in the close note.

options.title: Request a narrow rebase/extract
options.body: Ask for a fresh PR that keeps only unique UX or test value and fixes the credential, acknowledgement, env/launchd auth, and proof blockers.

options.title: Keep this branch for manual adoption
options.body: A maintainer can take over the branch, but should first rebase onto current main and remove behavior that conflicts with the merged onboarding architecture.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded after maintainer confirmation
recommendation.body: Treat the merged local Gateway bootstrap and Crestodian onboarding work as the canonical direction, preserving any useful discussion links in the close note.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged current-main macOS setup/onboarding direction and is the clearest owner for deciding whether this older protected branch still has unique value.
